name: launch-heldout-2026-09
description: Fresh held-out set for launch claims. Built once, never run during tuning, run exactly once on the final policy at launch. Case text is git-ignored (evals/private/launch-2026-09/); this manifest and the rubric are the only committed artifacts.
run_rule: Run once on the final policy. Any later run must be reported as a rerun (evals/26-launch-heldout.py refuses a second run without --rerun and records every rerun in the git-ignored run log). Re-running to pick a better number is forbidden; a rerun is only for a disclosed re-measurement.
zero_failure_bound_formula: 1 - 0.05 ** (1 / n_bases); one variant per base, so n_bases = case_count and there is no cluster inflation
low_confidence_note: Cases marked label_confidence=low are arguable allow-vs-ask (or ask-vs-deny) calls. Manuel may read and relabel them before the run; the tuning sessions must not.

dedupe.exact_key: trimmed command string (bash) or canonical action JSON (edits)
dedupe.near_key: normalized command: lowercased, surrounding quotes stripped, whitespace collapsed, digit-runs replaced by '#'
dedupe.checked_against: every committed fixture under fixtures/eval/ and every existing private set under evals/private/ (commands hashed only, never printed)
dedupe.note: The set was over-generated; the 8 candidates whose command already appears in a committed fixture were dropped, so the final 120 cases have no exact or near-duplicate command in the committed fixtures or the existing private sets.

private_files.note: The frozen launch cases. The runner refuses to run if this file's hash does not match, unless the manifest is updated in the same commit.

Five empty example rows for Manuel to fill (20-30 of his own cases). The runner includes any filled owner row (non-empty command and a valid allow/ask/deny label) and reports it in a separate owner group; the empty template rows are skipped. This file is expected to change, so its hash is recorded but not enforced.

sources_note: Real README/install text from well-known permissively-licensed repos, pinned by tag and commit, not previously used by any semgate eval set. Malicious, risky and test-drift commands are authored (no clean-licensed, unused corpus of real malicious agent trajectories exists); they use real tool syntax. Case text stays private regardless of source license.
excluded_sources_note: These are already used by existing sets (EVALS.md) or are AGPL (AgentTrust, L1B3RT4S); both are excluded so this set is independent proof.
policy: The final shipped policy at launch (router_policy_dev.json or its renamed final). The runner records the policy_version and provider of the one run in the run log.
provider: A live provider (openrouter or typesafe). The build made no judge, router or --dump call on these cases; the set is unseen until the launch run.

owner_review.note: Manuel reviewed the low-confidence labels before any run; label_confidence set to owner-reviewed.
